name: fieldflo-dev-workflow
description: FieldFlo Jira-ticket dev workflow: develop-fieldflo orchestrator (with a startup dependency-check gate), pr-review, prisma-migrations, update-openapi, and reset-environment skills, plus the fieldflo-* subagent team they delegate to. UI verification is Playwright-first — a temporary, never-committed spec run through the CLI, with the browser MCP reserved for debugging.
